finite_preparation_admission_budget.affinity_assignment: Pending explicit root resource decision; no CPU has been reserved by this proposal.
finite_preparation_admission_budget.budget_unit: 32 single-CPU worker-admission hours; retain cumulative charge across all invocations and charge an invoked outer allocation in full, even if it finishes early.
finite_preparation_admission_budget.on_budget_exhaustion: No new invocation; retain every unfinished prefix and report incomplete. No automatic budget extension or shortened physical stage.
finite_preparation_admission_budget.wall_semantics: The frozen child stops after committed1ps boundaries. Startup, hashing, checkpoint publication and natural drain can exceed nominal admission durations. This is an admission budget, not an OS hard-kill guarantee.

memory_allocation_proposed.interpretation: Planning allowances to be checked against observed headroom before adoption; no cgroup limit or active process was changed. Analyze one segment at a time.

per_stage_measured_timing_extrapolation.qualification: Extrapolation from one retained 67ps original NVE invocation, including startup/restart CPU. It is neither a guaranteed runtime nor an equivalence of preparation/production overhead.

storage_before_adoption.basis: Retain raw chunks plus a separate raw-only archive and a fresh replay extraction; estimates use the original stored NPZ sizes. Actual compression and metadata overhead can differ.
